Players Committee card image of [[Captain Cassian Andor]] (original printing), game text: “Deploys -1 if a Rebel leader on table. Once per game, may place a character in your Lost Pile out of play to cancel a just drawn weapon or battle destiny here. If just lost, may activate 1 Force. While at opponent's location immune to attrition < 4.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/captaincassianandor.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
